name: anti-slop
description: Rewrites AI prose tics out of text Claude is about to publish, in English and Dutch. Commit messages, PR and issue text, comments, READMEs and docs are checked against a pattern catalogue and published in their plain form, with no report. Also runs on demand against a file. A hook denies a commit, PR, issue or comment once when its text hits a catalogue entry, so Claude rewrites it before it is published.
